data.title: PayPal makes key leadership changes, including a new CFO; former Goldman exec joins board
data.description:
PayPal Holdings named a new chief financial officer on Friday as the company unveiled several leadership changes meant to establish clear strategies across the company's core businesses, simplify its operating model, and align accountability with the company's long-term priorities.

Clare Bramley will become executive vice president and chief financial officer as of Feb. 1, 2027, succeeding Jamie Miller, who guided the company through a CEO transition. Bramley comes from Xero, a global small-business platform, where she served as CFO since April 2025. Before Xero, she served as CFO and Teradata and held senior finance roles at HP.

PayPal also named new heads for its Consumer Financial Services & Venmo and Payment Services & Crypto units, as well as a new executive to lead AI Business Transformation & Operations. Its chief risk officer, Aaron Webster, will leave the company.

PayPal stock fell 2.8% in premarket trading.

Separately, the company said Brian J. Lee, Goldman Sachs' former chief risk officer, will join PayPal Holdings' board as of Nov. 30, 2026. Lee, with more than 30 years of experience in financial services, developed expertise in enterprise risk management, financial oversight, regulatory capital, and corporate governance.

"His financial acumen, understanding of complex global financial institutions, and commitment to strong governance will provide important perspective as we continue to advance PayPal's long-term strategy and deliver value for our shareholders," said PayPal Chair David Dorman.

As for other leadership changes, Kartik Mani will join PayPal as president and head of Consumer Financial Services & Venmo. He comes from American Express, where he currently serves as president of global network and partner services.

Suzan Kereere, who currently serves as PayPal's head of Global Markets, will become president and head of Payment Services & Crypto businesses. She succeeds Jeff Pomeroy, who has served as interim lead and will continue to manage Payment Services & Platform.

Juan Rio will join the company on Nov. 30, 2026, to become executive vice president of AI Business Transformation & Operations. He joins from Brightstar AI, where he serves as managing director and chief delivery officer.

Frank Keller will continue to lead Checkout Solutions & PayPal, including branded checkout.

Ratinder Bedi, senior vice president of Credit and Fraud Risk, will serve as interim head of the risk organization, while the company searches for a permanent successor to Webster.

data.title: REG - Aseana Prop Ltd - Board Appointment
data.description:
RNS Number : 1116E Aseana Properties Limited 20 November 2026  

20 November 2026

ASEANA PROPERTIES LIMITED

(“Aseana” or the “Company”)

Board Appointment

Aseana , a property developer in Malaysia listed on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange, is pleased to announce the appointment of Ms Caryn Lim Su Yin as a Non-Executive Director of the Company with effect from 20 November 2026.

Following her appointment to the Board, Caryn has appointed Ms Gemma Lim Su Xian as her alternate director, also with effect from 20 November 2026, pursuant to Article 19 of the Company’s Articles of Association. Gemma will act in Caryn’s absence in accordance with the Articles.

Caryn

Caryn has experience in investment management, equity capital markets and business management. She is currently head of Libra Capital Holdings Pte Ltd, a family office in Singapore, overseeing investment strategy and portfolio management. She previously worked in equity capital markets at Credit Suisse in London. Caryn holds an LLB from the London School of Economics and Political Science and an MSc in Management from Cass Business School.

Gemma

Gemma is currently Brand Director of Ormond Group, where she leads brand strategy and marketing across its hospitality portfolio and oversees the development and launch of new hotel concepts. She previously held business development and strategy roles at SCDA Architects, Post Company and Selina, and worked in investment management at AlTi (formerly LJ Partnership). Gemma holds an MBA from Columbia Business School and a BSc in Economics from the London School of Economics and Political Science.

Caryn and Gemma are discretionary beneficiaries of the Garynma Trust, which holds the beneficial interest in Garynma MY Capital Limited (“Garynma Capital”). Garynma Capital holds 473,541 ordinary shares of US$0.05 each in the Company, representing approximately 0.16% of the Company's issued ordinary share capital. As set out in the Company’s announcement of 26 November 2025, Garynma Capital is part of an existing concert party in the Company which comprises Neuchatel Investment Holdings Limited (a company owned by Mr Lim Kian Onn, father of Caryn and Gemma) and Garynma Capital.

The Board welcomes Caryn and Gemma and looks forward to their contributions to the Company.

data.title: Jensen Huang's $350 Million CoreWeave Deal Raises Questions About AI Financing
data.description:
CoreWeave (CRWV, Financials) is set to receive $350 million in computing-related spending from the charitable foundation established by former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and his wife, Lori, according to recent tax disclosures.

The Jen-Hsun & Lori Huang Foundation's last filing revealed the promise. A June Nvidia filing named CoreWeave as the receiver and indicated $108.3 million spent.

The funding supports the Computing Initiative for Open Science, which gives researchers access to large-scale GPU computing resources.

The foundation does not directly use computing power, CoreWeave claimed. Scientific research grant awardees receive the resources.

Investors are scrutinizing AI infrastructure firms' financial interactions with consumers. For its cloud computing company, CoreWeave relies on powerful GPUs. Nvidia is a key stakeholder.

This is the Huang Foundation's greatest 2025 donation. Almost three times its 2024 donations, the organization gave $373 million last year.

At Dec. 31, 2025, its assets were $12.7 billion, up from $9.2 billion. About 90% of the assets were Nvidia shares.

The foundation gave the California College of the Arts $19 million and the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology $1.2 million.

CoreWeave investors see the pledge as more computing service demand, but it also shows how the AI infrastructure sector is financially intertwined.

Investors will scrutinize future disclosures for CoreWeave's remaining computing obligations and revenue contribution.

data.title: RAG foundation still aims to cut Evonik stake after BASF exit
data.description:
Evonik's top shareholder, the RAG foundation, said on Friday it still aims to gradually reduce its stake in the German chemicals company to 25.1%, after BASF ended its pursuit of Evonik.

  • "We regret that BASF has abandoned its efforts to acquire Evonik without any in-depth exploratory talks having taken place between the executive boards of the two companies," the foundation told Reuters in a statement.

  • BASF abandoned its pursuit of Evonik after it said its smaller rival remained unwilling to engage despite a potential further increase of its takeover offer.

  • Shares in Evonik lost 16% in a record daily drop on Thursday, closing at €18, well below BASF's most recent offer of €24.

  • As part of its efforts, BASF approached the government of North Rhine-Westphalia, where Evonik is based, and the RAG foundation, outlining commitments on plants, jobs and training, two people familiar with the matter said.

  • NRW state premier Hendrik Wuest sits on the board of trustees of the RAG foundation, which holds 43% of the group's shares. Any sale of the foundation's shares would require the board's approval.

data.title: PPG named to TIME Magazine’s ‘America’s Top Manufacturers 2027’ list
data.description:
PPG () today announced its inclusion in TIME Magazine’s America's Top Manufacturers 2027. The list recognizes the strongest 250 manufacturing companies across three categories: financial performance, innovation capacity and employment excellence. PPG ranked third in the Chemicals and Materials group and No. 43 overall.

“This recognition is a testament to the dedication and expertise of our employees around the world,” said Bryan Iams, PPG chief communications officer. “Every day, our teams develop innovative solutions, advance our manufacturing capabilities and help customers solve complex challenges. This recognition reflects our commitment to protecting and beautifying the world through sustainable innovation and operational excellence.”

America’s Top Manufacturers 2027, developed in conjunction with data analysis firm Statista, lists the top 250 companies based on a range of financial, innovation and employment metrics. These include sales and profit growth, R&D spending and patent assets, and employee productivity and turnover. The list only includes companies that had sales of more than $100 million in 2025 and have manufacturing facilities in the U.S.

PPG: WE PROTECT AND BEAUTIFY THE WORLD®

At PPG (), we work every day to develop and deliver the paints, coatings and specialty products that our customers have trusted for more than 140 years. Through dedication and creativity, we solve our customers’ biggest challenges, collaborating closely to find the right path forward. With headquarters in Pittsburgh, we operate and innovate in more than 50 countries and reported net sales of $15.9 billion in 2025. We serve customers in construction, consumer products, industrial and transportation markets and aftermarkets. To learn more, visit www.ppg.com.

The PPG Logo and We protect and beautify the world are registered trademarks of PPG Industries Ohio, Inc.

data.title: Moog Inc. Announces Cash Dividend
data.description:
The Board of Directors of Moog Inc. (NYSE: MOG.A and MOG.B) declared a quarterly dividend of $0.30 per share on the Company’s issued and outstanding shares of Class A and Class B common stock. The dividend will be paid on December 16, 2026, to shareholders of record as of the close of business on December 7, 2026.

Future declarations of quarterly dividends are subject to the determination and discretion of Moog’s Board of Directors.

About Moog Inc.

Moog is a worldwide designer, manufacturer, and systems integrator of high-performance precision motion and fluid controls and control systems. Moog’s high-performance systems control military and commercial aircraft, satellites, and space vehicles, launch vehicles, defense systems, missiles, automated industrial machinery, marine, and medical equipment. Additional information about the Company can be found at www.moog.com.

data.title: InPost S.A. (INPST) Is Now Wholly Owned by Consortium and Delisted
data.description:
Advent, FedEx, A&R and PPF completed their acquisition of InPost, which is now wholly owned by the consortium and delisted from Euronext Amsterdam. The consortium holds 37%, 37%, 16% and 10%, respectively.

data.title: Faron’s Financial Calendar 2027
data.description:
Faron Pharmaceuticals Ltd | Company announcement | November 20, 2026 at 15:00:00 EET

TURKU, FINLAND – Faron Pharmaceuticals Ltd. (AIM: FARN, First North: FARON), a global, clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on creating innovative cancer treatments that leverage the patient’s own immune system, today announces the following dates for the Company’s financial reporting in 2027:

3 MarchFinancial statement release for the full year 2026 and Annual Report 2026 including financial statements for the full year
26 AugustHalf-year financial report for the period January 1 to June 30, 2027

The Annual General Meeting is planned to be held on 30 March 2027. A separate stock exchange notice will be issued by Faron’s Board of Directors to convene the meeting.

About bexmarilimab

Bexmarilimab is Faron’s proprietary, investigational immunotherapy designed to overcome resistance to existing treatments and optimize clinical outcomes by targeting myeloid cell function. It binds to Clever-1, a receptor on immunosuppressive macrophages that helps cancer evade the immune system. By targeting Clever-1, bexmarilimab reprograms the tumor microenvironment to ignite a potent anti-tumor immune response.

About Faron Pharmaceuticals Ltd

Faron (AIM: FARN, First North: FARON) is a global, clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, focused on tackling cancers via novel immunotherapies. Its mission is to bring the promise of immunotherapy to a broader population by uncovering novel ways to control and harness the power of the immune system. The Company’s lead asset is bexmarilimab, a novel anti-Clever-1 humanized antibody, with the potential to remove immunosuppression of cancers through reprogramming myeloid cell function. Bexmarilimab is being investigated in Phase 1/2 clinical trials as a potential therapy for patients with hematological cancers and solid tumors in combination with other standard treatments. Further information is available at www.faron.com.
